reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and a named lab with the batch report on the page is the first time a TikTok supplement answered my 'is it really tested' question. $24.99 for the first box is under a dollar a day, so I'd try one box.
objection: It's made in China, and I can't tell yet if the lab report is real until I scan the QR code on my own box. I'd also still want to check with my doctor that 200 mg is the right dose for me.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the page didn't match a batch number, or the lab turned out not to be a real independent one I can look up, I'd pass.
